metric: QLIKE (lower is better) on observed liquidation intensity

check_1_loio.name: Leave-One-Instrument-Out (LOIO) Sensitivity
check_1_loio.description: Re-evaluate C2 vs B1 on each 7-instrument subset (8 runs, each holding out one of the 8 instruments from the sealed PASS universe).
check_1_loio.procedure: For each held-out instrument in [ZEC, NEAR, UNI, AAVE, CRV, ADA, LTC, BCH]: build panel subset excluding that instrument; run pre-registered C2 vs B1 evaluation (identical features, splits, bootstrap seed=20261111, 2000 reps) on the remaining 7 instruments; record rel QLIKE reduction % and 95% CI.
check_1_loio.pass_criterion: PASS if >=6 of 8 LOIO runs show rel QLIKE reduction >=2% AND 95% CI excludes zero (hi < 0) favoring C2. FAIL otherwise.

check_2_placebo_permutation.name: Placebo/Permutation on Funding Features
check_2_placebo_permutation.description: Permute `fundingRate` and `abs_funding` across time within each instrument (fixed seed 20261112) to destroy any temporal relationship while preserving marginal distributions. Recompute C2 vs B1 on permuted data.
check_2_placebo_permutation.procedure: For each of the 8 instruments independently: within the panel, permute the `fundingRate` column across timestamps (shuffle with replacement? No, permute without replacement - random permutation of the column values within that instrument). Do the same for `abs_fund_pct`. Keep all other features (RV, premium, ema_dist) and the target unchanged. Re-run C2 vs B1 evaluation (identical features except permuted funding, identical splits, bootstrap seed=20261112, 2000 reps). Repeat for 1000 placebo permutations to build null distribution of rel QLIKE reduction.
check_2_placebo_permutation.pass_criterion: PASS if the TRUE (original, non-permuted) rel QLIKE reduction (19.04%) > 95th percentile of the placebo null distribution. FAIL if true reduction <= 95th percentile (i.e., p >= 0.05).

check_3_bootstrap_settings.name: Alternative Block/Bootstrap Settings
check_3_bootstrap_settings.description: Re-evaluate C2 vs B1 on the full panel with three alternative pre-specified bootstrap configurations to test sensitivity to block size and bootstrap method.
check_3_bootstrap_settings.procedure: Run C2 vs B1 evaluation on the full 8-instrument panel with the following settings (all other aspects identical to sealed PASS): (a) block_size=48h, circular block bootstrap, 5000 reps; (b) stationary bootstrap with mean_block=24h, 5000 reps; (c) circular block bootstrap with block_size=24h (original) but 5000 reps. Use fixed seed 20261111 for (a) and (c); seed 20261112 for (b).
check_3_bootstrap_settings.pass_criterion: PASS if ALL THREE settings yield rel QLIKE reduction >=2% AND 95% CI excludes zero (hi < 0) favoring C2. FAIL if any setting fails either criterion.
check_3_bootstrap_settings.note: Original PASS used circular block_size=24h, 2000 reps, seed=20261111. This check tests robustness to block size doubling, stationary bootstrap, and increased reps.

overall_verdict_rule.ROBUST: All three checks (LOIO, Placebo/Permutation, Bootstrap Settings) PASS.
overall_verdict_rule.FRAGILE: Any one check FAILS. Document exact failure mode.
overall_verdict_rule.INCONCLUSIVE: Computational infeasibility (e.g., memory/time exhaustion) prevents completion of any check. Document specific infeasibility.

next_on_fragile: If FRAGILE: document exact failure mode; preregister and attempt next best admissible untested claim in-session (e.g., alternate volatility design on cached HL 2025-11..2026-10 with different pre-specified horizon/features/splits) repeating Steps 1-4. Do not stop at first failure.
event_adequacy_rule: Same as sealed PASS: claim-worthy only if >=5 paired instruments with label coverage in test blocks, >=3 non-overlapping 30-day test blocks with data, RV24h/B1 computable for test blocks, label variance >0 across test blocks.
